en: UCLA Empire Bay's news home on Bob Ehrman. Wildfires devastate much of the western states today. Residents in California, Oregon, Washington, Arizona and New Mexico all were forced to flee from their homes earlier today as fires broke out for much of the western coast. The fires started early this morning and have quickly engulfed thousands of acres already. Volunteers from as far as Ohio and Texas have joined the fight in what investigators believe, at least for now, is the result of dry conditions and high wins. For Empire Base News Leader, UCLA, I'm Bob Barraman.
